# 🚀 CodePilot AI

Welcome to CodePilot AI.

An open-source developer assistant built with Python to help programmers analyze code, improve software quality, and generate documentation.

## 🎯 Mission

CodePilot AI aims to make software development more accessible by providing simple tools that help developers understand, improve, and maintain their code.

## ✨ Current Features

- Python code analysis
- Syntax error detection
- Function quality checks
- Automatic documentation generation
- Automated testing
- Continuous Integration with GitHub Actions

## 🛠️ Technology

Built with:

- Python
- AST code analysis
- Pytest
- GitHub Actions

## 🌱 Open Source

Contributions, suggestions, and improvements are welcome.

The project is designed to grow together with the developer community.

## 🗺️ Future Plans

- AI-powered code explanations
- Advanced code review features
- More programming language support
- Developer productivity tools

Made with ❤️ for the open source community.
